messages:
kevin: Quick a11y pass after the model-compare demo. Kept things tight. Found a few medium/high nuisances that block keyboard/SR flows. Posting so eng/design can triage.

nina: thanks  which screens exactly?

kevin: model-compare panel, streaming token rail, and compact action chips in the results list. Top items:
1) token rail uses aria-live and updates per-token; NVDA/VO read every update and it’s noisy. We should make the stream visually real-time but quiet to SRs (announce only completion/errors).
2) result list chips are div[role=button] with custom key handlers but lack focus-visible styles and proper accessible names. At 200% zoom the focus is visually lost.
3) compare drawer: when opened via keyboard, focus lands correctly, but closing (Esc or Close) sometimes leaves focus inside the hidden drawer. Need restoreFocus to the originating compare toggle.
4) small primary action ("Run diff") in dark mode is borderline contrast at 12px; fails AA.
5) charts: tiny stacked bars rely on color alone; low-contrast segments are indistinguishable. Consider stroke or pattern for thin segments.

pablo: environment?

kevin: macOS Safari + VoiceOver and NVDA+Firefox for cross-check. Used axe + our internal contrast script.

dar_dev_ishaan: plan: 1) implement "SR-quiet" pattern for streaming: keep per-token visual updates, but use inert or aria-hidden on token elements and only update a role=status offscreen announcer on complete. 2) convert chips to <button> with aria-pressed for toggle state and add .chip:focus-visible rule (3px outline). 3) add focusRestore() in drawer close handler and cover with e2e keyboard test. 4) bump primary token or increase font weight. 5) chart: add 1px stroke token for marks <6px wide.

tara: copy/UX notes: change chip tooltip from "Select" to "Select result" so SR context is included. For the stream announcer text use short phrase: "Generation complete: 214 tokens". Avoid per-update phrases like "token 1 of 214".

kevin: small code snippets for PRs:
```js
// announcer update on completion
const announcer = document.getElementById('stream-announcer');
announcer.textContent = `Generation complete: ${tokenCount} tokens.`;
// make token elements inert for SRs
tokenEl.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
```
```css
/* chip focus */
.chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: none; }
:root { --color-primary: #5b38ff; /* meets 4.5:1 at 12px */ }
```

pablo: a11y-bot, did the scan pick this up?

a11y-bot: Automated scan: 7 issues found. Severity: 2 high (live-region flooding, focus restore), 3 medium (interactive semantics, contrast, chart micro-contrast), 2 low (decorative svg announcements). Full report: /internal/a11y/reports/2468201111

nina: prioritization: live-region & focus restore P0. chip semantics + contrast P1. charts P2.

dev_ishaan: i'll submit two small PRs: 1) stream announcer + e2e keyboard test for generative flow 2) chip -> button refactor + focus-visible + drawer focus restore. Will include screenshots for dark/light and aria examples. Drafts by EOD.

tara: i'll update Figma tokens for focus and primary color and change the tooltip copy.

kevin: thanks everyone. after merges I'll run a quick VoiceOver pass and post a single verification line. Appreciate the quick turnaround :sparkles:
